name: AHS Krab
origin: Poland (Huta Stalowa Wola; K9 chassis, AS-90-derived turret)
protection: Light armour against splinters and small arms. Game: immune to 5.56/5.45/7.62x39/7.62x51; 7.62x54R and larger can penetrate side/rear and disable wheels, engine and optics; every launcher in the game list penetrates.
visual_notes: K9 Thunder tracked chassis: 6 road wheels per side, driver front-left, engine front-right
Large slab-sided box turret (AS-90 Braveheart lineage) set well back, long L/52 barrel with a fume extractor and muzzle brake
Barrel rests in a travel lock on the glacis when moving
Rear hull door for ammunition resupply; Ukrainian examples heavily netted

colour_schemes.name: Ukrainian army green with field netting
